title: Work Orders — Board View and Tech View: two questions for the product owner (15 Oct 2026)
intro: Project: Work Orders — Board View and Tech View display options. Both questions come from testing on staging. Each row says what a user sees today and offers options; please mark one in the last column.

rows.topic: Board View and Tech View — coming back with the browser's Back button
rows.now: When you open a work order from Board View or Tech View and then press the browser's Back button, the sideways position comes back exactly. The up-and-down position can come back about one row off: the column lines itself up on the nearest card, so a card that was half hidden at the top is no longer shown.
rows.question: The requirement says Back brings back both the up-and-down and the sideways position. Is coming back within about one row good enough, or must it be exactly where the user left it?
rows.options:
(a) Within about one row is fine — we pass it as it is.
(b) It must be exact — we report it to the developers as a fault.
(c) Something else — please describe.

rows.topic: Board View cards — how the names of technicians who are clocked in are shown
rows.now: On a Board View card, the Clocked in field shows the first clocked-in technician's full name, then +1 for each other person, for example "Cora Clock +1". The List's Clocked In column shows it the same way. Pointing at it lists every name.
rows.question: The requirement says the card shows clocked-in technicians "the way the List's Clocked In column shows them today", and then describes that as "first name, then +N" (for example "Cora +1"). But the List actually shows the full name. Which did you mean: the same as the List (full name, then +N), or the first name only, then +N?
rows.options:
(a) The same as the List — full name, then +N. We pass it as it is.
(b) First name only, then +N — we report the card to the developers (please also say whether the List should change).
(c) Something else — please describe.

internal: S1-R8 says "restores" with no tolerance; staging comes back up to one row off vertically. The QA lead (15 Oct) asked to put it to the product owner rather than judge it.
C96978 (Fields to display, Clocked in) — Automated
PRD 845185030 v52, optional fields list and S2-R20, read 15 Oct 2026

The source contradicts itself: "the way List's Clocked In column shows them today" (the List shows full name +N) vs "first name, then +N". Rule 58: an ambiguous source is held and asked, never settled by the build. The QA lead chose to ask (15 Oct).
